headlines.title: 3 Great Undervalued Stocks To Own In November 2026
headlines.summary: The dollar is heading for a fourth straight week of gains as higher US yields pull money toward cash and away from risk. That kind of risk-off mood can leave some solid companies trading below what their future cash flows might justify. For investors hunting mispriced value, this creates a window. This article highlights three stocks that screen as potentially undervalued on cash flow.

headlines.title: MongoDB faces lower expectations ahead of earnings as Bank of America cuts price target
headlines.summary: MongoDB Inc (NASDAQ:MDB) faces a lower bar for growth when it reports third-quarter financial year 2027 results on December 1, with Bank of America (BofA) warning that concerns about execution have reduced expectations for its Atlas cloud database business.

headlines.title: Bank of America Corporation (BAC): One of the Best Affordable Blue Chip Stock to Buy Now
headlines.summary: We just published the list of the 10 Best Affordable Blue Chip Stocks to Buy Now and Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) ranked 8th on this list. Blue-chip stocks are often associated with established businesses, strong financial positions, and the ability to generate returns over extended periods.

headlines.title: Roblox shares face near-term pressure as Bank of America maintains 'neutral' rating
headlines.summary: Roblox Corp (NYSE:RBLX) has an improving growth outlook for 2027 as artificial intelligence (AI) accelerates game development, but Bank of America (BofA) has maintained its 'neutral' rating, advising investors to wait for the impact of Grand Theft Auto 6 to become clearer.

headlines.title: Viridian Therapeutics initiated at 'buy' by Bank of America with $47 price target
headlines.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has initiated coverage of Viridian Therapeutics (Nasdaq: VRDN) with a 'buy' rating and a $47 price objective, citing the potential of its thyroid eye disease treatments to capture market share and expand an undertreated market.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
